scope: Common semantic conformance with a scripted caller and actual measurement engine

scenarios.property: A failed probe remains a fact while explicit gates and caller assessment stay independent
Caller satisfaction cannot override a failed required check
Incomplete domain preparation retains the Run and can be resumed
Two interpretation revisions preserve original intent and cumulative budget
A revised interpretation cannot weaken a pinned gate
Old facts persist without passing gates for a new submitted subject
Caller notes and source labels cannot create verifier facts
Activity, assumptions and task relationships survive a fresh caller instance
A new check revision cannot inherit the old revision's pass
Earlier measurements survive a later adapter error
A real killed worker retains completed checkpoints without publishing final success
A trusted test module can replace Domain behavior without Core edits
Explicit strict policy continues to require every registered check
A budget handoff can close with a final untrusted assessment and no invented evidence
Old strict request fingerprints and stored records remain readable without automatic execution
One Run cannot cite another Run's verifier observations
The existing agent-tool CLI can prepare, revise, measure, assess and close with separate meanings
Hypotheses, observations, decisions, interpretation revisions and reported task states retain explicit relationships
A known input scope can be measured while final criteria are unknown, then refined within the same Run
